note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. The episode is copied to a neutral folder C:\lab\plNN so no user name shows in paths.

screens.name: editor-extension
steps: Open the folder C:\lab\pl02, dark theme, font size 18 or larger; wait for the C# Dev Kit to load AdvancedCSharp.slnx
On the requests.TotalBudget line delete 'TotalBudget' and type 'requests.' again (or press Ctrl+Space)
Frame the completion list: TotalBudget and HighPriority with the property icon
Press Escape and undo (Ctrl+Z) so the file is unchanged
Optional second frame: hover clock.Today to show it comes from TimeProviderExtensions
mask: window title and Explorer root if they show a user name
